user_request: Make sure the images are in github. We need more and different enemies too.
scope: Eight new authored enemy concepts and sixteen static reference sheets in the established Havenline visual style. These are creative proposals authorized by the latest request, not newly source-observed enemies or runtime canon.

subjects.name: Shield Raider
subjects.silhouette: broad square torso; large shield on anatomical LEFT arm; short hammer in anatomical RIGHT hand
locks: one shield on left forearm
one hammer in right hand
shield outer front has steel boss; inner back has straps, never a duplicate outer face
flat metal cap and cheek guards; no rifle or red hood

subjects.name: Harpoon Hunter
subjects.silhouette: tall lean female scout; long upward spear; small leather tether coil
locks: one simple harpoon in anatomical RIGHT hand
one fixed rope coil on anatomical LEFT hip
no firearm or fishing rod
two-handed aiming/throw-prep only in action sheet; tether anatomy stays consistent

subjects.name: Powder Sapper
subjects.silhouette: short round figure with tall cylindrical backpack and padded goggles
locks: one closed cylindrical backpack
two broad brown shoulder straps
one sealed fictional charge canister in right hand; no active flame
no real explosive construction diagram, no gun, no mechanics claim

subjects.name: Frost Stalker
subjects.silhouette: lean long feline torso, large paws, long ringed tail
locks: four legs and one long tail
closed natural paws with retracted claws in turnaround
no harness or armor
snow leopard-like pattern without copying wolf or bear body

subjects.name: Tusk Boar
subjects.silhouette: low broad russet/cream body, snout and exactly two upward tusks
locks: four cloven-hoofed legs
two tusks only
one short tail
bristle ridge; no dorsal stone spikes or bear claws

subjects.name: Musk Ox Rampager
subjects.silhouette: massive shoulder hump, shaggy skirt and broad lateral horns
locks: four cloven-hoofed legs
two lateral curled horns with wide connected-looking frontal bosses
horn topology identical across angles
no antlers, no upright humanoid stance

subjects.name: Frostwing Raptor
subjects.silhouette: large hooked beak, powerful folded wings and broad tail fan
locks: exactly two wings and two bird legs
each visible open foot has three forward toes and one rear toe
no arms or mammalian paws
folded wing turnaround; takeoff/glide/landing static poses only

subjects.name: Armored Ram Sled
subjects.silhouette: low wide tracked chassis, projecting horizontal ram, raised rear engine housing
locks: exactly two continuous track assemblies
four road wheels per track plus front and rear rounded end wheels
one centered horizontal blunt ram beam
one short centered rear exhaust stack
no worker operator, no cannon, no snowplow blade, no machinery cutaway claims

required_sheets_per_subject: six-panel details and static action poses
style: Chunky rounded sculpted winter 3D; blue/orange gear accents, brown leather, cream shearling, sculpted fur/feathers, snow touches, navy presentation boards. No gritty photorealism or new aesthetic. Enemy roles read by silhouette and equipment, not recolor alone.
mandatory_checks: All16 selected boards pass independent visual review >=9.5, target9.9, with every mandatory check passed.
Eight genuine ordered views including opposed left/right and full rear; consistent identity and anatomical handedness.
Six detail/static-use panels for each; species or mechanical part counts remain coherent.
New enemy concept labels and proposed roles are clear; no false source-canon, mesh, rig, animation-cycle or runtime approval.
Every produced image and revision plus exact prompts and raw review records is committed to GitHub.
All prior repository file objects stay unchanged; additive archive only.
Live remote commit/tree and all original/selected image blob hashes and sizes independently verified.

preservation: Do not alter earlier approved images, prompts, reviews, runtime code or source-coverage findings. YT13 and unavailable-source limits from the prior audit remain unresolved, separate from these authored new designs.
